summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 7 (Buddilio: real socials, city SEO pages, monthly leaderboard, local pricing). Tested guest flows (/cities, /city/dubai, /city/london, /city/vancouver waitlist, /city/atlantis not-found, footer socials, city→events prefill), member leaderboard (Tara J.), partner event create+edit with currency, and Omar's currency picker on Events. 6/7 critical flows pass. One real UI bug: mobile 390px horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=457 vs innerWidth=390) on both /city/dubai and /cities. Also minor spec deviations documented.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on 390x844: scrollWidth=457 vs innerWidth=390 (~67px overflow) on both /city/dubai AND /cities. Spec required scrollWidth === innerWidth. Hero/stat cards or grid likely using min-widths / fixed paddings that exceed viewport.

Invalid email path does NOT show a sonner error toast — HTML5 type=email native validation short-circuits submit before the client can toast. Spec asked for an explicit error toast. Consider changing input to type=text with regex + toast.error, or add a custom onInvalid handler.

integration_issues.flow: Partner → Create event → Country change to UAE
integration_issues.issue: Auto-switches city to 'Abu Dhabi' (first city in UAE list) instead of 'Dubai' as spec required. Currency correctly auto-switches to AED. In Partner.jsx line 156: `city: c?.cities?.[0] || f.city` — picks first city. If Dubai should be default for UAE, either reorder cities array (put Dubai first) or add a country→default-city map.

Row 1 shows 'Tara J. · 7 invites · ₹1,750 earned' but spec expected 6 invites / ₹1,500. All other rows match spec exactly (Sofia M. 4/₹1,000, Liam O. 3/₹750, Kabir N. 2/₹500, Omar R. 1/₹250). Likely seed_referrals.py granted 7 rewarded invites to Tara instead of 6. Ordering, badges (Ambassador), highlight, name masking (First L.), and 'you' badge all correct.

Could NOT fully verify 'organiser-priced-in-AED shows exact AED on card + event detail' because NO live/published event has price_overrides populated in seed data. The only override event created during this test (TEST_Dubai_AED_Event) is in draft state and city defaulted to Abu Dhabi. However: code paths in Cards.jsx (fmtOf(ev.price, ev.price_overrides)), Events.jsx (data-testid='event-price', event-local-price), and CurrencyContext.jsx (fmtOf exact override wins over FX) are all correctly implemented. Recommend seeding at least one PUBLISHED Dubai event with price_overrides={AED: <n>} so this can be verified visually.

action_items: HIGH: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on /city/:slug and /cities (scrollWidth 457 > innerWidth 390 at 390x844). Audit hero, city-stats grid, and category chips for fixed widths / negative margins.

MEDIUM: When Country changes to United Arab Emirates on partner create-event form, default city should be 'Dubai' not 'Abu Dhabi' (Partner.jsx line 156). Either reorder cities for UAE (Dubai first) or add explicit country→default-city map.
LOW: Waitlist invalid email should raise a custom toast.error instead of relying on browser native email validation (spec asked for error toast).
LOW: Seed variance — Tara has 7 rewarded invites (₹1,750) instead of spec's 6 (₹1,500). Reconcile seed_referrals.py or spec.
LOW: Cleanup 1 TEST_ event created by testing agent: 'TEST_Dubai_AED_Event' (draft, city=Abu Dhabi, price=250 AED) under partner@buddilio.com.

INFO: To fully verify local-pricing display, seed at least one PUBLISHED Dubai event with price_overrides={AED: n} so [data-testid='event-price'] and [data-testid='event-local-price'] can be verified visually.
critical_code_review_comments: CurrencyContext.jsx fmtOf: correctly gives override precedence over FX conversion — implementation is sound.
Cards.jsx EventCard now uses fmtOf(ev.price, ev.price_overrides) — regression from prior 'fmt is not defined' is confirmed fixed.
Partner.jsx onChange for country: sets city to first cities[0] which is Abu Dhabi for UAE; consider country→default-city map for UX polish (Dubai for UAE, Bangkok for Thailand, etc.).

Cities.jsx waitlist: uses type=email — browser native validation prevents onSubmit from running with an invalid email, so the toast.error path is unreachable via the UI (only reachable if user disables browser validation). Consider `noValidate` on the form + client regex + toast.error to make the negative flow user-visible.
Preview environment: emergent-tagger injecting <span> children into <option> elements causes React hydration warnings on Events page and Partner form. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow (~67px extra) on /city/dubai and /cities most likely caused by hero content using a fixed grid or the stat cards row exceeding container. Repro: viewport 390x844 → document.documentElement.scrollWidth=457. Likely culprits: (a) footer city marquee running full width, (b) city-stats grid with fixed min-widths, or (c) city category chips row without wrap. Mitigation: audit for min-w-*, w-[>390px], or gap combinations; ensure `overflow-x-hidden` on the page container or use `min-w-0` on flex/grid children; wrap the marquee in an `overflow-hidden` parent.
